Clear BVFS cache.

## Synopsis

```text
.bvfs_clear_cache [yes]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Clears the whole BVFS cache in the catalog: Job.HasCache is reset for all jobs and the tables PathHierarchy and PathVisibility are emptied. The keyword yes is required; without it nothing happens and there is no confirmation prompt. Afterwards the cache must be rebuilt with .bvfs\_update. Backup data and file records are not touched.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `yes` | keyword |  |  |  | Confirm. |

## Examples

Empty the BVFS cache:

```text
.bvfs_clear_cache yes
```
